text:
alex: Heads up — planning a short deploy for runtime v3.4.1 at 11:30 PT today. Target: model routing fix + batch-size tweak. Need quick checks & signoffs.
priya: I can own smoke tests. Which endpoints should I hit?
alex: Smoke: /v1/generate (20 tokens), /v1/chat (multi-turn), embeddings sample. Run against staging first. I'll post commands.
alex: Smoke commands:
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"smoke test","max_tokens":20}'
```
daphne: I'll watch latency dashboards and set a 5-min baseline. Ping me at deploy start. Also confirm canary % and timeline.
chris: Canary 10% first 10m, then 50% for next 10m if green. Rollback: toggle routing back to v3.4.0 and drain new nodes; I can run the script.
priya: Ran smoke on staging just now — all endpoints responding, samples look fine. No obvious errors in logs.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: window requested by alex for 11:30 PT (UTC-7). Build bld-2026-312 queued.
oncall-ops: I'm on-call for the window. Thresholds: >2% error rate OR sustained 5xx spike for 2m -> trigger rollback. Use #incidents for escalation.
alex: Need approval from owners: @daphne (latency), @chris (rollback), @priya (smoke). Reply 'ack' to sign off.
daphne: ack :thumbsup:
chris: ack — rollback steps rehearsed and doc pinned in #eng-releases
priya: ack — smoke green, ready to run during canary
alex: Great — kicking at 11:30 PT. I'll post live updates.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deploy started at 11:30 PT, tracking id df-2026-312
alex: Canary 10% deployed, monitoring logs & traces now.
daphne: +2m no latency regressions on p50/p95
chris: +4m no 5xx spikes, metrics look clean, okay to ramp to 50% in 5m
alex: Ramping to 50% now.
priya: Running smoke suite at 50% — all tests passing, sample outputs look correct
alex: If green at +12m we go full at 11:50 PT. Thanks everyone for quick turn. Will post final confirmation once done.
